resources.string: Detects X.com and Twitter in Chrome and shows a local Focus Lock screen during blocked hours.
X is allowed for up to 15 minutes, then your normal schedule resumes
Accessibility service: Off — Focus Lock can\'t block anything until this is turned on

Some banking apps warn about (or block) any active accessibility service, as a fraud-prevention measure — this isn\'t specific to Focus Lock. Turn the toggle above off before opening those apps, or set up Android\'s Accessibility Shortcut for a faster on/off than coming back to this screen.

This app does not use VPN, Device Admin, root, or any screen-lock control — nothing that could make the phone unusable. The only special permission is the Accessibility Service you turn on above. To stop Focus Lock at any time: turn that service off, or uninstall the app.
